text:
Javed: Vendor IstanbulCloud LTD invoiced Redwood B.V. and appended a note asking us to gross-up for a 15% Turkish withholding. They also charged 18% KDV on the invoice. Anyone seen Turkish WHT on cross-border SaaS/consulting? :thinking:

Sonia: Do not pay grossed amount without docs. Which Redwood legal entity is on the PDF? That decides VAT vs withholding.

Javed: PDF shows bill to Redwood B.V. (Netherlands). Snippet: ```
Invoice: 2026-11-07-IC
Supplier: IstanbulCloud LTD
Tax no: TR 987 654 3210
Amount: EUR 9,250
KDV (VAT): 18% charged EUR 1,665
Vendor note: "Please gross-up 15% withholding so supplier receives net after Turkish WHT."
Description: Cloud migration advisory (remote)
```

TaxTeam: Turkey can have withholding on certain technical/service payments when sourced in Turkey, and KDV applies to taxable supplies. However, if the invoice is issued to a non-Turkish entity for cross-border services, KDV and WHT treatment can vary. Charging KDV to a Dutch company seems suspicious unless vendor has a local permanent establishment or specific rules apply.

TaxTeam: Key ask: request from vendor (1) explanation why KDV was charged to a non‑resident payer and (2) legal basis for claiming 15% WHT on payment from a Netherlands entity. Also ask for Turkish tax office correspondence, a residency certificate, and any contract clause that would force us to gross-up. We don't gross-up commercially by default.

Sonia: I'll draft reply and flag AP to HOLD. Draft: "We cannot gross-up by default. Please provide evidence from Turkish tax authorities or a tax assessment showing WHT applies, a Turkish tax residency certificate, and reissue the invoice clarifying why KDV was charged and the invoiced legal entity. Payment will remain on hold until clarified"

Legal: If they produce a contract clause requiring gross-up we can review, but absent that it's a commercial ask. Also ask them whether they want us to withhold and remit on their behalf or to increase the invoice value. Operational difference matters for AP.

AP: HOLD applied to invoice 2026-11-07-IC in Coupa. Please send the exact text for the vendor email and I'll forward.

Javed: I'll send vendor note now and CC Legal/Tax. Will paste any reply here.

invoice-bot: Payment status updated: ON HOLD for invoice 2026-11-07-IC (IstanbulCloud LTD) by AP  reason: awaiting vendor tax documentation and invoice clarification.

Sonia: If they push back, ask them to cite the specific Turkish statute or provide the tax office decision. If they provide a residency cert only, that generally helps them avoid foreign WHT but doesn't create an automatic right to gross-up.

Javed: Thanks all 44d will update thread when vendor replies.
